concept: Macie: discovering and classifying PII in S3
tests: Which service finds and classifies sensitive data (PII) in S3 buckets for privacy compliance.
expected: Amazon Macie — ML-based discovery and classification of sensitive data (PII) in S3. Triggers: "discover and classify sensitive data", "PII", "S3", "privacy compliance".
why_not: GuardDuty — threat detection; AWS Config — resource configurations; CloudTrail — API activity; none of them analyzes object contents.
